diagnostics.message:
Type mismatch: After simplification, term
  fun hab => Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top hab fun k => 1 / ↑k
 has type
  ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + 1 + 1), (↑x)⁻¹ = ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + 1), (↑x)⁻¹ + (↑n + 1 + 1)⁻¹
but is expected to have type
  ∑ x ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (n + 1), (↑x)⁻¹ = ∑ x ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (↑x + 1)⁻¹
